messages:
olivia: Heads-up — the quickstart in samples/hello-redwood has a creds example that causes 401s when copied. README shows `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` but the current Python SDK reads `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
jess: which file exactly? can you paste the snippet?
olivia: path: samples/hello-redwood/README.md. snippet from README:
```
export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=\"sk-prod-...\"
python run.py
```
and run.py does:
```python
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ[\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\"])
```
so env var mismatch -> KeyError/401.
max: yeah that changed around sdk v0.4 — we standardized naming to REDWOOD_API_KEY. README didn't get updated in the sample repo.
sam: simple options: 1) update the README to use REDWOOD_API_KEY, and 2) make the SDK resilient for one release by checking both env vars (`os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY') or os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_TOKEN')`) and logging a deprecation warning.
jess: i'll open a tiny PR to update the README + add a note in samples/README about the env var name. committing to patch now. commit message: "docs(samples): harmonize env var name to REDWOOD_API_KEY"
olivia: please also add a short migration note in CHANGELOG.md for the sample-apps folder so users running old quickstarts see it.
docs-bot: PR opened by jess: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/142 — updates hello-redwood README and adds migration note.
max: also update the Node and Bash examples while you're there. Node quickstart should use:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN });
```
and add a comment about the fallback.
sam: can we add a tiny CI lint that verifies sample READMEs don't reference the old var? maybe a grep in samples/ci/validate-readmes.sh
jess: adding a test in samples/.github/workflows/validate.yml — quick grep for REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and fail if present (except CHANGELOG entries). will push in the same PR.
olivia: awesome, thanks @jess and @max. once PR merges can someone run a quick smoke on the hosted quickstart docs publishing job? want to ensure website picks up update.
jess: will follow up after merge and ping #eng-docs for the site deploy. :thumbsup:
olivia: thanks all — good catch. closing this thread when PR merged.
